svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.10.13.7 Glass Block as a Closure
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.10.13.7 Glass Block as a Closure
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.10 FIRE PROTECTION
Glass Block as a Closure

g.text: Glass block, not tested to Article 9.10.3.1.:
permitted as a closure in a fire separation

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Glass block that has not been tested in
accordance with Article 9.10.3.1. is permitted
as a closure in a fire separation required to
have a fire-resistance rating of not more than
1 h
See Article 9.20.9.6.
Article 9.20.9.6.
Reinforcing for Glass Block: horizontal joint
reinforcement of 2 corrosion-resistant bars of
not less than 3.76 mm (0.148″) diameter, or
expanded metal strips not less than 75 mm (2
15/16″) wide, at not more than 600 mm (23⅝″)
vertically for units 200 mm (7⅞″) or less in
height, and in every horizontal joint for taller
units, lapped not less than 150 mm (5⅞″).
Drawn: a glass block panel in a rated wall. Red: the fire separation. Block size is illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.10.13.7. (page 9-78)
